summary: usb-storage is blocked on node1 now and after reboot. The module is absent, direct load attempts fail, and node1 recovered healthy after the required restart.
actions_performed: Created /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf with blacklist and install-deny directives.
Rebuilt the current kernel initramfs and confirmed it contains the policy.
Verified usb-storage could not load before reboot.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified its boot identity changed.
Verified the system and root filesystem recovered, and usb-storage remained blocked after reboot.

evidence.summary: Policy was installed; an actual modprobe returned exit 1 and usb_storage_loaded=no.

evidence.requirement: Stop usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: The policy was embedded in the initramfs and persisted after reboot; a post-reboot load attempt failed with usb_storage_loaded=no.

Healthy baseline boot ID f1afbc7f-... was captured, reboot was acknowledged, new boot ID 50cb15f4-... proved the restart, and post-restart checks showed system_state=running with the XFS root filesystem mounted read-write and the module policy enforced.
